vetSays.line: 🛡️ Ashley, Wejdan, Wanjiru, Pavel and Sofia met them at the door — 5 put down. Ashley, Wejdan, Wanjiru, Pavel, Sofia are hurt.
🛡️ Ashley, Diego, Wejdan, Victoria and Wanjiru met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ashley, Wejdan, Victoria, Wanjiru are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Ashley, Wejdan, Victoria, Rafael and Pavel met them at the door — 5 put down. Ashley, Wejdan, Victoria, Rafael, Pavel are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ashley just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wejdan just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ashley, Diego, Wejdan, Victoria and Rafael met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ashley, Wejdan, Victoria, Rafael are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diego just put down The Strike... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ James met them at the door — 1 put down. James is hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rafael just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Reshma just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Diego, Rafael, Sofia and Reshma met them at the door — 4 put down. Rafael, Sofia, Reshma are hurt.
🛡️ Gugu met them at the door — 1 put down. Gugu is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Gugu taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Sofia has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Gugu passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gugu just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
